[[File:Supernova-TSW.jpg|250px|thumb|A [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-induced supernova]]
{{Quote|Without precise calculations, we'd fly right through a star, bounce too close to a supernova, and that'd end your trip real quick, wouldn't it?|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
A '''supernova''' occurred when a giant [[Star/Legends|star]] ceased to fuse light elements into heavier elemental products. The loss of internal heating allowed the star to collapse onto itself to form a [[Neutron star/Legends|neutron star]] or a [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]]. Supernova could happen naturally or be induced by a [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]].

If a star was massive enough to perish in a supernova explosion, it produced, in its final stages of [[nuclear fusion]], large amounts of heavy elements in its core. The supernova then scattered these elements into the surrounding nebulae.

==Known supernovae in the galaxy==
[[File:Denarii_supernova.png|thumb|right|250px|The Denarii supernova]]
*The supernova in the Kashi system, becoming the [[Orixon Nebula/Legends|Orixon Nebula]]
*The [[Din supernova|supernova]] of [[Din]] around 5000 BBY that created the [[Din Pulsar/Legends|Din Pulsar]] in the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]]
*The supernova created by [[Primus Goluud/Legends|Primus Goluud]]
*The supernova created by [[Denarii Nova|Denarii]]
*The artificial destruction of the [[Cron Cluster/Legends|Cron Cluster]], caused by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] on the [[Corsair (Derriphan-class)|''Corsair'']]
*The supernova forcing the near-human population of [[Hettitite]] to migrate elsewhere.
*The supernova that became the [[Utegetu Nebula/Legends|Utegetu Nebula]]
*The supernova created by [[Demophon (star)|Demophon]]
*The artificial destruction of [[Caridan (star)|Caridan]], caused by the [[Sun Crusher]]
*The quintuple supernova in the [[Cauldron Nebula/Legends|Cauldron Nebula]], caused by the Sun Crusher
*The artificial destruction of [[TD-10036-EM-1271]], caused by the [[Centerpoint Station]]
*The artificial destruction of [[Thanta Zilbra (star)|Thanta Zilbra]], caused by the Centerpoint Station
